title: cyclosorus × gogoii
intro: Cyclosorus × gogoii, commonly known as the Gogo fern, is a hybrid species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus × gogoii include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating various infections due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
